Stop exposing your app ports directly to the internet! 

Whether you use #NodeJS, #Python, or #Docker, you need a reverse proxy. #Nginx sits in front of your app, handles the traffic, and manages the HTTPS encryption safely.

Learn how to configure Nginx and automate #LetsEncrypt SSL certificates on #Ubuntu 24.04 in our new step-by-step guide:
https://www.eservers.uk/tutorials/howto/nginx-reverse-proxy-lets-encrypt-ssl-ubuntu-24-04/
